welcome.title: Let's get to know Tracta?
welcome.titleNamed: Hi, {{name}}. Let's get to know Tracta?
welcome.body: A quick tour of the main areas. It takes less than a minute.

done.title: Your pace starts now
done.body: You can replay this tour anytime in Profile → See app tour.

home.title: Home
home.body: Your summary of the day: sleep, movement, heart rate and the next workout. Tap "Edit" to pick and reorder the cards.

health.title: Health
health.body: Sleep and activity explained simply, always with the source of each data point. Tap a card to see day, week or month.

workouts.title: Workouts
workouts.body: Build your routines, start a free session or log a run, a walk and other activities.

session.title: During the workout
session.body: Adjust load and reps, complete the set and the rest starts by itself. Everything is saved on every tap, even offline.

history.title: History
history.body: Activity calendar, progress per exercise and per cardio, and 7- and 30-day reports.

profile.title: Friends and goals
profile.body: Invite friends to follow workouts and create daily challenges. Goals, connections and privacy also live here.
